model.name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA pi-H3 DWD 4-Step 33B
model.description: Video with synchronized audio from text and optional first/last frames in only 4 steps on the full 33B model: no guidance pass, and the last step delivers the frames directly, so there is no video decoding to wait for. Pick it for fast drafts and iteration that still look good; textures are a little softer than with a regular decode.
